strategy4Ws.title: The 4 Ws Strategy
strategy4Ws.what: What? What are they doing? (use Present Continuous)
strategy4Ws.when: When? What time of day or season is it?

strategySpatial.title: Spatial Vocabulary
strategySpatial.tip1: In the middle/background of the photo…
strategySpatial.tip2: On the left/right of the picture…
strategySpatial.tip3: Behind the people, there is a…

strategySpeculation.title: Speculation (Bonus points)
strategySpeculation.tip1: Use phrases like 'Perhaps', 'Maybe' or 'It looks like…'

tipsModal.goalNote: Goal: Try to speak for 60 seconds straight without long pauses.

tips: Practising 10 minutes a day works better than one hour a week.
Saying words out loud helps your brain remember them.
Mistakes are part of learning. Don't worry about getting it wrong!
Repeating what you hear greatly improves your pronunciation.
The more you play with the language, the faster you learn it.
Take a deep breath before speaking. You've got this!
Listening to songs in English is also practising.
Bob is here to help you. Have fun with the practice!
